newsitem.title: GERMANY: Behring, Dade say sign definitive pact on merger.
newsitem.headline: Behring, Dade say sign definitive pact on merger.

text.p: Behring Diagnostics, a unit of Germany's Hoechst AG, said on Thursday that Hoechst and Dade International have completed an agreement for the previously announced merger of Behring with Dade.
Behring said the merger, depending on the length of review by European and U.S. regulatory officials, is expected to be completed by late summer or early fall.

The new company, which sells products and services for clinical laboratories, will be called Dade Behring Inc and will have annual sales of more than $1.5 billion and a staff of 8,700 employees, Behring said in a statement.
The merger was an equity transaction under which Hoechst, the German chemicals group, will own 32.5 percent of Dade Behring.

U.S.-based Dade's current owners, Bain Capital, Goldman Sachs Capital Partners and Dade's management, will own the balance but Hoechst will have first right to acquire the salres of Bain and Goldman if they wish to sell.
Dade's headquarters in Deerfield, Illinois, will serve as headquarters for the combined company, while a branch office will be located in Frankfurt.
